$comment: Floors for the OpenSSF Scorecard checks that gate the weekly run (.github/workflows/scorecard-thresholds.yml). Scores are 0 to 10; -1 (not scored) fails. Vulnerabilities at 10 means any open OSV advisory against a locked dependency fails the run. Raise a floor when the score is reliably above it; lowering one is a reviewed change with a reason here.
